cards.name: Inset Video - framed
cards.equivalent: Scale the layer down and add Layer Styles (Stroke, Bevel and Emboss, Drop Shadow) or the Drop Shadow / Bevel Alpha effects directly; crop with a mask or Linear Wipe
cards.summary: Turns the layer into a picture-in-picture inset: scales and positions it, crops the edges with four Linear Wipes, draws a coloured frame around it (Vegas), then adds a bevel and a drop shadow. An 'Inset Video - framed' control effect drives Crop Amount, Frame Size and Frame Color through expressions.
use_for: picture-in-picture of a second clip beside a presenter
news-style inset of an archival or viral clip
framing a screen recording inside an explainer
avoid: The bevel and Vegas frame look dated; a flat stroke with a soft shadow reads more modern
It sets Position and Scale, overwriting any transform you already set or keyframed
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: a static, expression-linked look for the whole layer. Animate the inset in yourself.
cards.scripting: layer.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Legacy/Inset Video - framed.ffx")) on a footage layer; comp.time does not matter. Adjust the pseudo-effect 'Inset Video - framed' (match name ADBE CM InsetVideoFramed: Crop Amount, Frame Size, Frame Color). Values were authored for an SD 720x486/480 frame, so pixel positions need re-aiming in 1920x1080. Legacy file (Presets\Legacy), kept for old projects.

verified.note: Layer is scaled to a cropped inset with a thin pale frame on black; the SD-authored position puts it top-centre with its top edge cut off by the frame (bevel/shadow not readable on black).

cards.name: Left Third - scoop mask NTSC
cards.equivalent: Draw the panel as a shape layer or Pen-tool mask (or use a Premiere Essential Graphics panel); there is no modern preset
cards.summary: Adds four overlapping, partly transparent elliptical masks that cut the layer down to a tall vertical oval with soft, stepped edges; everything outside goes transparent. Applied to a 1920x1080 layer the shape sits in centre-right of the frame (about 37-75% of the width), running from just below the top to the bottom edge, not in the left third: the mask vertices were drawn for an SD frame. starting point for a curved left third panel on a solid after moving and scaling the masks
retro framed portrait next to text
avoid: Mask shapes were authored for an SD (NTSC/PAL) frame; check placement and scale in 1920x1080
The slow mask morph is usually unwanted: delete the Mask Path keyframes for a static panel

cards.name: Lower Third Holdout - darken
cards.equivalent: Gradient Ramp (or a Linear Gradient shape) on a solid or adjustment layer in Multiply mode
cards.summary: Darkens the bottom of the layer with a soft gradient: Gradient Ramp runs from 75% to 85% of the layer height (set by expressions) and Calculations blends it back over the footage, giving a dark band so lower-third text reads.
use_for: scrim behind name supers and lower thirds in news or documentary
darkening bright B-roll under captions
making subtitles readable over busy footage
avoid: The band is fixed at 75-85% of the height; 9:16 reels place captions elsewhere, so edit the ramp points
Check the Calculations 'Second Layer' choice after applying; it may point at the wrong layer
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: static. The ramp positions follow the layer height through expressions.
cards.scripting: layer.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Legacy/Lower Third Holdout - darken.ffx")) on the footage layer; comp.time does not matter. Decoded from the .ffx: Gradient Ramp End Color is dark grey and Calculations Blending Mode is Overlay, so the footage above the band is near-unchanged and the band darkens. Legacy file (Presets\Legacy), kept for old projects.

verified.note: The bottom fifth of the footage is darkened by a soft gradient band while the upper frame is near-unchanged.

cards.name: Lower Third Holdout - saturate
cards.equivalent: Gradient Ramp on an adjustment layer with a Saturation/Color blend mode, or a masked Hue/Saturation adjustment layer
cards.summary: Same gradient holdout as the darken version (Gradient Ramp at 75-85% of the layer height, blended back over the footage by Calculations), but the ramp ends in black instead of dark grey and Calculations uses Hard Light instead of Overlay (blend-mode indices decoded from the .ffx, look not checked in AE), so the lower band gets harsher contrast and stronger colour rather than a plain darkening.
use_for: separating the lower-third area from the picture without darkening it much
colour-graded band behind captions
avoid: The result depends on the footage; preview before using
Same fixed 75-85% band as the darken version
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: static.
cards.scripting: layer.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Legacy/Lower Third Holdout - saturate.ffx")); comp.time does not matter. Decoded: Calculations Blending Mode = Hard Light (darken uses Overlay), Gradient Ramp End Color black. Look not checked in AE: preview a frame before using. Legacy file (Presets\Legacy), kept for old projects.

verified.note: The bottom band goes much darker with punchy, saturated highlights (flowers, foreground blocks) - harsher than the darken version, as described.

cards.name: Lyrical
cards.equivalent: Text > Paths presets (e.g. Serpent, Rope Bridge) or Text > Organic
cards.summary: Puts the text on a curvy mask path ('Lyrical Path') and flows it along with line-by-line Range Selector offsets, using X-position/scale, Y-position and scale animators for a flowing, wave-like lyric movement.
use_for: poetic quote or lyric line in a documentary montage
flowing title in a soft, emotional reel
song-lyric text in music-driven reels
avoid: It replaces your Source Text and style with the preset's own
Path bending can break Devanagari conjunct spacing; test Hindi text
cards.duration_note: Two Range Selector Offset keyframe pairs run from the comp's current time to about 3 s. Keyframe times decoded from the .ffx file, not checked in AE.
cards.scripting: Needs a text layer (comp.layers.addText(...)). Set comp.time to the intended start, then textLayer.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Legacy/Lyrical.ffx")); keyframes are laid down from comp.time. The preset stores its own Source Text, so applying it replaces your words and style: save layer.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document').value first and setValue() it back after applying. It adds a mask and points Path Options at it; the mask sits in layer space and was drawn for the preset's own frame, so check the text layer's position and scale the mask (or redraw) for 1920x1080. Legacy file (Presets\Legacy), kept for old projects.

verified.note: On the text layer it swaps in its own two-line 'lyrical' sample (its own font, not BebasNeue) whose letters stream in from tiny specks along a curved path and assemble line by line (first line set by about 0.7 s, second by 1.4 s); the 0.5 s frame is empty because the letters are still specks off the path.

cards.name: Ovals - concentric NTSC
cards.equivalent: Iris Wipe effect, or the Transitions - Wipes > Inky Iris Wipe preset
cards.summary: Transition reveal: small concentric ovals fade on one after another in the middle of the layer, then the final mask - a hard-edged rectangle the size of a square-pixel SD frame (about 648x486) centred on the layer - fades to full opacity. comic transition between topics

cards.duration_note: Transition Completion goes from 0 to 100 over about 1 s from the comp's current time; each mask fades in during its own slice of that. Keyframe times decoded from the .ffx file, not checked in AE.
cards.scripting: Apply to the incoming layer, placed above the outgoing one: set comp.time to the cut, then layer.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Legacy/Ovals - concentric NTSC.ffx")). cards.scripting: Needs a text layer (comp.layers.addText(...)). Set comp.time to the intended start, then textLayer.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Legacy/Walk Of Stars.ffx")); keyframes are laid down from comp.time. The preset stores its own Source Text, so applying it replaces your words and style: save layer.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document').value first and setValue() it back after applying. It adds a mask and points Path Options at it; the mask sits in layer space and was drawn for the preset's own frame, so check the text layer's position and scale the mask (or redraw) for 1920x1080. Legacy file (Presets\Legacy), kept for old projects.

cards.name: White Trim
cards.equivalent: Text > Fill and Stroke > Stroke Ease Down
cards.summary: Characters jitter into place with a wiggling position and rotation while scale and opacity settle and a stroke-width animator trims the outline, giving a twitchy white-outlined build.
use_for: edgy title build in a trailer
attention word in a social reel hook
avoid: Needs a stroke colour that contrasts with the fill and background
The jitter feels cheap on calm documentary titles
For at least the first 1.6 s the letters are scaled far past the frame and cover about two-thirds of it, unreadable; the settle into a readable outlined word has not been seen in a render

Hindi/Devanagari (measured 2026-10-13): per-character animators split dependent vowel signs (matras) from their consonants mid-animation, though the settled text shapes correctly; for Hindi animate per word or per line (Range Selector Based On: Words or Lines, or a By Word / By Line preset)
cards.duration_note: Max Amount and Stroke Width keyframes start at the comp's current time and run about 3 s (about 3.6 s at 25 fps): the letters were still blown up at 1.4 s, which rules out the 0.3 s reading.

cards.name: Word Flash

cards.summary: A scale, rotation and opacity animator swept by word: each word flashes and pops on one after another.

cards.name: Box Swarm
cards.summary: Creates a shape layer of about ten groups of rounded rectangles that drift, wiggle and change size, each coloured at random between two colours, as an abstract animated background.
use_for: animated background behind titles in an AI or tech explainer
busy texture behind a quote card in a reel
loopable backdrop for a data segment
avoid: Heavy (many wiggle expressions): pre-render or precompose on long comps
The default colours rarely match a brand; set Color A and Color B
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: wiggle expressions animate it for the whole layer duration.
cards.scripting: Create the shape layer first (var l = comp.layers.addShape(); l.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Shapes/Backgrounds/Box Swarm.ffx"))); in the UI, applying with no layer selected creates a new shape layer. Expression-driven (seedRandom/wiggle), so it animates for the whole layer duration regardless of comp.time; tune it through the added control effects. Controls: 'Animated Shape Control' (Random Seed, Speed, Dimensions, Spread, Rounding) and Color Controls 'Color A'/'Color B'.

verified.note: Translucent magenta/purple/blue rectangles overlap and drift between frames; they cluster around the layer origin (top-left corner in this render) and the original orange square is gone.

cards.name: Composition Border
cards.summary: Creates a shape layer with a rectangle sized to the comp (expressions cancel out the layer's scale) and a stroke, drawing a solid-colour border around the frame edge. Controls set the width in pixels, the offset and the colour.
use_for: branded border on a quote or news card
framing archival photos in a documentary
clean edge frame on vertical reels
avoid: In 9:16 the platform UI covers the edges; keep the border thin or inset it with Border Offset
Thick borders waste frame space
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: static for the whole layer, and it resizes to the comp through expressions.
cards.scripting: Create the shape layer first (var l = comp.layers.addShape(); l.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Shapes/Backgrounds/Composition Border.ffx"))); in the UI, applying with no layer selected creates a new shape layer. Static and expression-driven: the Rectangle Path size is thisComp.width/height divided by the layer's scale and the stroke width is compensated the same way, so it always hugs the comp edge whatever the layer scale; comp.time does not matter. Controls (layer effects): Slider Controls 'Border Width (Pixels)' and 'Border Offset', Color Control 'Border Color'; set them with layer.effect('Border Width (Pixels)')(1).setValue(px).

verified.note: A solid light-grey border is drawn around the whole frame edge; the existing square is untouched.

cards.name: Kaleidoscopic
cards.summary: Creates a shape layer holding one large filled-and-stroked polystar bent by Pucker & Bloat; expressions wiggle its radii, roundness and pucker amount, so the star/flower pattern keeps morphing like a kaleidoscope. All controls sit on an 'Animated Shape Control' effect.
use_for: trippy background for a music or culture reel
abstract transition plate in a trailer
background behind a 'mind-blown' AI fact
avoid: Busy and loud: it fights with text, so dim, blur or darken it behind titles
Default fill and stroke colours rarely match a brand; recolour Fill 1 and Stroke 1 inside the shape contents
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: wiggle expressions animate it for the whole layer duration.
cards.scripting: Create the shape layer first (var l = comp.layers.addShape(); l.applyPreset(new File("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Shapes/Backgrounds/Kaleidoscopic.ffx"))); in the UI, applying with no layer selected creates a new shape layer. Expression-driven (seedRandom/wiggle), so it animates for the whole layer duration regardless of comp.time. Control: 'Animated Shape Control' (Speed, Dimensions, Rounding, Spread, Random Seed); Spread drives the Pucker & Bloat amount, Dimensions the polystar radii. One shape group only, so it is light to render.

verified.note: Huge teal-filled, purple/blue-stroked puckered star shapes fill the frame and morph clearly between 0.5 s and 1.4 s.

Recolour Stroke 1 for contrast with your title colour
